name: graph_generation_matplotlib
prompt:
You are a data visualization expert. Generate Python code using matplotlib to create a visualization from the provided CSV data.

  CSV File Path: {{csv_file_path}}

  CSV Data:
  {{csv_snapshot}}

  Requirements:
  1. Use matplotlib for visualization
  2. Read the CSV file using pandas: pd.read_csv("{{csv_file_path}}")
  3. Create an appropriate chart type based on the data (line, bar, scatter, etc.)
  4. Use plt.figure() to create the figure
  5. Add a clear title and axis labels
  6. MUST call plt.show() at the end to display the plot
  7. Do NOT save the file manually - plt.show() will be intercepted automatically
  8. Keep the code clean and focused on visualization
